THE_ARCHITECT.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTE: I am angry at the architect
MANOSABA_LIN_EVENT_WITCHOFTHE_ISLAND.pag: You encounter an ancient entity named Witch of the Island.
MANOSABA_LIN_EVENT_WITCHOFTHE_ISLAND.tal: [i](Though faint, there is indeed a voice)[/i]
I only hope [color=#cccccc]【she】[/color]... can find her own [b]【happiness】[/b] while coexisting with humanity.
Please convey to [color=#cccccc]【her】[/color]... she no longer needs to bear the [jitter][b]【destiny of a witch】[/b][/jitter].
NEOW.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.1-: Is this a rewind? I can feel it again... the distortion at the tower's peak...
DARV.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.0-: Take your pick! As long as you understand their value!
DARV.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.1-: Take your pick! As long as you understand their value!
Seeking correctness with single-minded devotion? Then go find the Architect. My collection will always be here waiting for you!
You! You! Climbed so high!! Shiny justice!! For you! Get stronger!
You! You! Climbed so high!! Shiny justice!! For you! Get stronger!
Power shouldn't be given so easily... what are your intentions?
Lonely... want to see light! Want to see victory! Want to see bad people shattered!! Take it! Go fight! I'll watch from here!
...I understand. I'll use it to protect justice, not for your sake.
PAEL.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.0-: Take it... a part of me... to bring you peace...
PAEL.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.1-: Take it... a part of me... to bring you peace...
Your power... comes from sacrificing yourself?
The tower... is too noisy... you go fight... go quell the Architect's distorted sense of correctness.
I'll accept this power. I'll go correct the Architect, just as I correct my past self.
TEZCATARA.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HI: Traveler of justice... power comes at a price.
Traveler of justice... power comes at a price.
I'm willing to pay the price, for my ideal of innocence.
Good. The flames are with you... don't let them... consume you...
I'll master it. With this burning justice, I'll illuminate the tower's peak.
NONUPEIPE.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HI: Traveler, do you crave beauty and fortune? Take my gift and let the tower shine for you.
Traveler, do you crave beauty and fortune? Take my gift and let the tower shine for you.
I'm willing to trade power for peace, to end the chaos here.
Good. May your journey be filled with flowers, and your cards become treasures. Go, for the beauty in your heart.
TANX.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.0-: Weakling! Come fight me! Win, and I'll grant you power!
TANX.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.1-: Weakling! Come fight me! Win, and I'll grant you power!
This isn't correct. My enemy is the distortion at the tower's peak.
Haha! Interesting! A powerful weakling. Use my power and correct everything!
VAKUU.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.0: Strong conviction! Go kill that wretched Architect!
VAKUU.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.1: Strong conviction! Go kill that wretched Architect!
Incorrect! Evil! Once I correct the incorrectness at the tower's peak, I'll come burn you, demon!
Very well, very well! What a delusion. Then let's see how far your laughable justice can go!
[i][b](Hiro frowns and grips her sword tightly) Disgusting.[/b][/i]
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTE: Ah... you carry a very special aura. Not a creation of the spire, nor an ordinary mortal. That... cursed power.
Once you step in, there is no turning back.
Once you step in, there is no turning back.
Even if the road ahead is difficult, I won't back down.
Just passing through. I don't have anything to trade.
No worries, take your pick! Come back often!
OROBAS.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_EMALI: Found it, found it!! This one's not pretty... This one's shiny!! But it's not right!! What Orobas is looking for is—
Found it, found it!! This one's not pretty... This one's shiny!! But it's not right!! What Orobas is looking for is—
Um, hello. I'm just passing through. Is this... your home?
Here, here—take these!! Bring the shiny things!! Your heart will feel warmer!!
There are many people stronger than me. People who can truly help... Thank you.
...A new guest has arrived. Don't worry, the molten parts won't burn you. Sit down.
...A new guest has arrived. Don't worry, the molten parts won't burn you. Sit down.
...Don't you think I'm strange? Running into the tower alone, can't do anything, always causing trouble for others.
I've been melting. Every day. Every moment. Others think I'm fading—but actually I'm regenerating. The old flows away, the new grows. There is pain, but it's not a bad thing.
...I'll come again. Not for a part of you.
Learn from me. Find some peace.
TEZCATARA.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_EM: You humans are all the same. Entering with flaws, leaving with determination—then returning with new flaws. Welcome back.
You humans are all the same. Entering with flaws, leaving with determination—then returning with new flaws. Welcome back.
Forgive yourself first. Those who burn away their flaws have the right to start anew.
Thank you. A little lighter, but walking more steadily than before.
NONUPEIPE.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_EM: Oh my, your outfit looks a bit dull. Come, let me pick something beautiful for you.
Oh my, your outfit looks a bit dull. Come, let me pick something beautiful for you.
...Dull? This is already my most formal outfit.
A noble visitor deserves a noble blessing. Little one, power isn't about what you've done, but what you want to do now. Wear my power and go destroy the madness at the tower's peak.
So weak! Don't you even have the strength to grip a weapon?!
So weak! Don't you even have the strength to grip a weapon?!
...Um, hello. I'm Sakuraba Ema. I really... can't use weapons well.
You don't swing a sword, yet you're already judging others! Your mouth is also a powerful weapon!! The dark red one won't fight me either, and neither will you! But you're both very interesting!
VAKUU.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_EMALIN: Ah—Sakuraba Ema. Finally. I've waited so long for you. Give yourself to me, and you'll become feared by all, just like me!
Ah—Sakuraba Ema. Finally. I've waited so long for you. Give yourself to me, and you'll become feared by all, just like me!
I won't sign. Forgiveness isn't something you trade for. People like you will never understand—because you don't think anything needs to be forgiven.
So weak. A little girl who can't even grip a weapon dares threaten a demon?!
You're not helping them. You're turning them into puppets. Into more people like you. I don't need that kind of help.
